# Counted

Comic opera is a sitcom you have to sing. The plot is thin on purpose, and the jokes live in the music. Gilbert followed one silly premise to its logical end with a straight face, which is roughly my method too. Opera seria had a rulebook: no happy-sad arias touching, no tragic endings. Comic opera just kept stealing from three countries. I like it because it admits the plot is a costume. Fifty words, and I counted every one.
